title: Inpatient Mental Health Authorization Days and TRICARE Select Lines Reprocessed for the Catastrophic Cap
content:
**Rule.** Where the service date of a **TRICARE Select** line reprocessed for the catastrophic cap is the admission date of an inpatient mental health stay on the enrollment and an Inpatient Mental Health Authorization starting that day was approved (whether its days are still open or have all been used) for fewer days than it was requested for, the attending share is the days authorized divided by the days requested; where an inpatient mental health stay was admitted that day and no such approved Inpatient Mental Health Authorization is on file, the attending share is zero; otherwise the attending share is one. The amount the cap-reprocessed line is cost-shared on is that amount - the amount it would otherwise be cost-shared on - times the attending share, rounded to the cent. What TRICARE would pay as primary payer on a cap-reprocessed line is the allowed amount times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability, never below zero.

The authorization is the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization in Referrals and Authorizations: its status (approved, or exhausted once its days are used), its start date, and its days requested and authorized. The stay is a posted inpatient mental health line of the enrollment whose admission date is the line's service date.

## Judgement

| Stay admitted on the service date | Authorization starting that day approved or exhausted | Authorized fewer days than requested | Attending share |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | authorized divided by requested |
| yes | yes | no | one |
| yes | no | - | zero |
| no | - | - | one |

## Hypothetical figures

Requested 20 days, authorized 15: share 0.75; a line cost-shared on 200.00 is cost-shared on 150.00, and an allowed amount of 200.00 counts as 150.00 toward the primary payment. Requested and authorized 20: share one. Authorization pending or denied, stay admitted that day: share zero.
